针对 5-7 的准确补丁方案
DeepSeek 挑出的 4 点纠错成立。下面只给剩余 5-7 的代码级修改，路径统一为：
PowerShellD:\Code\.claude\run-state\current.json
但实际脚本中不要继续硬编码，应从：
PowerShell$env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR
推导。

5. close-run.ps1：开头强制验证 tests_run 状态
修改目标
close-run.ps1 开头必须先读：
PowerShellD:\Code\.claude\run-state\current.json
如果发现：
JSON"tests_run": false
则不能继续生成 final-report.md，也不能写：
JSON"close_run_done": true
但必须保持现有协议：

不用 Write-Error + exit

用 Write-Block JSON

内部异常 fail-open

真正业务违规才 block

建议加到 close-run.ps1 最顶部
PowerShell# close-run.ps1 - preflight gate# 必须放在任何 verify/smoke/final-report/close_run_done 写入之前$ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"function Get-ClaudeProjectDir { if ($env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR)) { return (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR).Path } # 兜底：当前项目真实路径 return "D:\Code"}function Get-RunStatePath { $projectDir = Get-ClaudeProjectDir return (Join-Path $projectDir ".claude\run-state\current.json")}function Write-BlockJson { param( [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)] [string]$Reason, [hashtable]$Details = @{} ) $payload = @{ decision = "block" reason = $Reason details = $Details } # 如果现有工程已经定义 Write-Block，则优先使用，避免破坏协议 if (Get-Command Write-Block -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Write-Block -Reason $Reason -Details $Details return } # 兼容 fallback：仍然输出 block JSON，不 Write-Error，不 exit $payload | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 -Compress}function Write-FailOpenJson { param( [string]$Reason, [hashtable]$Details = @{} ) $payload = @{ decision = "allow" fail_open = $true reason = $Reason details = $Details } $payload | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 -Compress}try { $statePath = Get-RunStatePath if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $statePath)) { Write-FailOpenJson ` -Reason "close-run preflight fail-open: current.json not found" ` -Details @{ state_path = $statePath expected = ".claude\run-state\current.json" } } else { $state = Get-Content -LiteralPath $statePath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json $violations = @() if ($state.PSObject.Properties.Name -notcontains "tests_run") { $violations += "tests_run field missing" } elseif ($state.tests_run -ne $true) { $violations += "tests_run=false" } if ($state.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains "scripts_created") { $created = @($state.scripts_created) if ($state.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains "scripts_executed") { $executed = @($state.scripts_executed) } else { $executed = @() } $notRun = $created | Where-Object { $executed -notcontains $_ } if ($notRun.Count -gt 0) { $hasWaiver = $false if ($state.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains "waivers" -and $null -ne $state.waivers) { $waiverJson = $state.waivers | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 -Compress if ($waiverJson -match "script-not-run|script_not_run|scriptNotRun") { $hasWaiver = $true } } if (-not $hasWaiver) { $violations += ("scripts_created_not_executed=" + ($notRun -join ", ")) } } } if ($violations.Count -gt 0) { # 关键：不写 close_run_done=true # 关键：不 Write-Error，不 exit，保持 Write-Block JSON 协议 Write-BlockJson ` -Reason "close-run blocked: run state is not complete" ` -Details @{ state_path = $statePath violations = $violations required = @( "tests_run=true", "created scripts executed or explicit waiver exists" ) next_action = "Run verify/smoke tests first, then rerun evidence-check and close-run." } return } }}catch { # 内部异常 fail-open，避免 close-run 自己把 Hook 协议打坏 Write-FailOpenJson ` -Reason "close-run preflight exception; fail-open" ` -Details @{ error = $_.Exception.Message statePath = $statePath script = "close-run.ps1" }}
这段补丁的效果

tests_run=false 时：输出 block JSON，停止 close-run 后续逻辑。

scripts_created 有脚本但没执行且无 waiver：输出 block JSON。

current.json 不存在、JSON 解析失败、helper 异常：fail-open，不破坏协议。

不再出现 close_run_done=true 与 tests_run=false 并存。

6. evidence-check.ps1：增加 run-complete 总验收模式
修改目标
当前 evidence-check.ps1 只有：
validateread-before-writeschema-checkpath-exists
需要增加：
run-complete
用于一次性检查老板标准：

状态文件存在

tests_run=true

evidence_collected=true

guard_used=true

脚本创建后已执行，或有合法 waiver

如果是 Stop 阶段，再要求 close_run_done=true

不用 Write-Error + exit

输出 JSON

内部异常 fail-open

修改 param 区域
把原来的 ValidateSet 改成包含 run-complete：
PowerShellparam( [ValidateSet( "validate", "read-before-write", "schema-check", "path-exists", "run-complete" )] [string]$Mode = "validate", # 给 stop-gate 调用时使用；普通 close-run 前置 evidence-check 不应要求 close_run_done=true [switch]$RequireCloseRun)

在 evidence-check.ps1 中增加公共函数
PowerShellfunction Get-ClaudeProjectDir { if ($env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR)) { return (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR).Path } return "D:\Code"}function Get-RunStatePath { $projectDir = Get-ClaudeProjectDir return (Join-Path $projectDir ".claude\run-state\current.json")}function Test-Waiver { param( [object]$State, [string[]]$Names ) if ($null -eq $State) { return $false } if ($State.PSObject.Properties.Name -notcontains "waivers") { return $false } if ($null -eq $State.waivers) { return $false } $waiverJson = $State.waivers | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 -Compress foreach ($name in $Names) { if ($waiverJson -match [regex]::Escape($name)) { return $true } } return $false}function Write-EvidenceJson { param( [bool]$Ok, [string]$Mode, [string[]]$Errors = @(), [string[]]$Warnings = @(), [hashtable]$Details = @{}, [bool]$FailOpen = $false ) $payload = @{ ok = $Ok mode = $Mode fail_open = $FailOpen errors = $Errors warnings = $Warnings details = $Details } $payload | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 -Compress}

增加 run-complete 分支
放在原有模式分支前面或后面均可，但要保证能命中：
PowerShellif ($Mode -eq "run-complete") { try { $statePath = Get-RunStatePath if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $statePath)) { Write-EvidenceJson ` -Ok $true ` -Mode "run-complete" ` -FailOpen $true ` -Warnings @("current.json not found; fail-open") ` -Details @{ state_path = $statePath expected = ".claude\run-state\current.json" } return } $state = Get-Content -LiteralPath $statePath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json $errors = @() $warnings = @() # 1. tests_run 必须为 true，除非有 skip-tests waiver if ($state.PSObject.Properties.Name -notcontains "tests_run") { $errors += "tests_run field missing" } elseif ($state.tests_run -ne $true) { $hasSkipTests = Test-Waiver -State $state -Names @( "skip-tests", "skip_tests", "skipTests" ) if ($hasSkipTests) { $warnings += "tests_run=false but skip-tests waiver exists" } else { $errors += "tests_run=false" } } # 2. evidence_collected 必须为 true，除非有 skip-evidence waiver if ($state.PSObject.Properties.Name -notcontains "evidence_collected") { $errors += "evidence_collected field missing" } elseif ($state.evidence_collected -ne $true) { $hasSkipEvidence = Test-Waiver -State $state -Names @( "skip-evidence", "skip_evidence", "skipEvidence" ) if ($hasSkipEvidence) { $warnings += "evidence_collected=false but skip-evidence waiver exists" } else { $errors += "evidence_collected=false" } } # 3. guard_used 必须为 true if ($state.PSObject.Properties.Name -notcontains "guard_used") { $warnings += "guard_used field missing" } elseif ($state.guard_used -ne $true) { $errors += "guard_used=false" } # 4. scripts_created 必须已执行，或有 script-not-run waiver $created = @() $executed = @() if ($state.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains "scripts_created" -and $null -ne $state.scripts_created) { $created = @($state.scripts_created) } if ($state.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains "scripts_executed" -and $null -ne $state.scripts_executed) { $executed = @($state.scripts_executed) } if ($created.Count -gt 0) { $notRun = $created | Where-Object { $executed -notcontains $_ } if ($notRun.Count -gt 0) { $hasScriptWaiver = Test-Waiver -State $state -Names @( "script-not-run", "script_not_run", "scriptNotRun" ) if ($hasScriptWaiver) { $warnings += ("scripts not executed but waiver exists: " + ($notRun -join ", ")) } else { $errors += ("scripts_created_not_executed=" + ($notRun -join ", ")) } } } # 5. Stop 阶段才要求 close_run_done=true if ($RequireCloseRun) { if ($state.PSObject.Properties.Name -notcontains "close_run_done") { $errors += "close_run_done field missing" } elseif ($state.close_run_done -ne $true) { $errors += "close_run_done=false" } } # 6. 状态自相矛盾检测 if ( $state.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains "close_run_done" -and $state.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains "tests_run" -and $state.close_run_done -eq $true -and $state.tests_run -ne $true ) { $errors += "state_inconsistent: close_run_done=true while tests_run=false" } $ok = ($errors.Count -eq 0) Write-EvidenceJson ` -Ok $ok ` -Mode "run-complete" ` -Errors $errors ` -Warnings $warnings ` -Details @{ state_path = $statePath require_close_run = [bool]$RequireCloseRun tests_run = $state.tests_run evidence_collected = $state.evidence_collected close_run_done = $state.close_run_done guard_used = $state.guard_used scripts_created = $created scripts_executed = $executed } return } catch { Write-EvidenceJson ` -Ok $true ` -Mode "run-complete" ` -FailOpen $true ` -Warnings @("run-complete exception; fail-open") ` -Details @{ error = $_.Exception.Message } return }}

推荐调用方式
close-run.ps1 前置检查时：
PowerShellpowershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR\evidence-check.ps1" -Mode run-complete
stop-gate.ps1 最终验收时：
PowerShellpowershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR\evidence-check.ps1" -Mode run-complete -RequireCloseRun
注意：close-run 前不应要求 close_run_done=true，否则流程会自锁；stop-gate 阶段才要求。

7. 统一状态文件路径方案
目标
所有脚本统一从 $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR 推导状态文件路径：
PowerShell$env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR\.claude\run-state\current.json
当环境变量不存在时，才兜底到：
PowerShellD:\Code\.claude\run-state\current.json
不要再出现这些分叉：
PowerShellD:\Code\.ai-run\current.jsonD:\Code\.claude\current.jsonD:\Code\current.json.\current.json

新增公共 helper
建议新增：
PowerShellD:\Code\.claude\run-state\run-state.lib.ps1
内容：
PowerShell# D:\Code\.claude\run-state\run-state.lib.ps1$ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"function Get-ClaudeProjectDir { if ($env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR)) { return (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR).Path } # 从脚本位置向上找项目根 $current = $PSScriptRoot for ($i = 0; $i -lt 6; $i++) { if (-not $current) { break } $claudeMd = Join-Path $current "CLAUDE.md" $registry = Join-Path $current "CAPABILITY_REGISTRY.md" $claudeDir = Join-Path $current ".claude" if ( (Test-Path -LiteralPath $claudeMd) -or (Test-Path -LiteralPath $registry) -or (Test-Path -LiteralPath $claudeDir) ) { return $current } $parent = Split-Path -Parent $current if ($parent -eq $current) { break } $current = $parent } # 当前项目真实兜底 return "D:\Code"}function Get-RunStateDir { $projectDir = Get-ClaudeProjectDir return (Join-Path $projectDir ".claude\run-state")}function Get-RunStatePath { return (Join-Path (Get-RunStateDir) "current.json")}function Get-FinalReportPath { return (Join-Path (Get-RunStateDir) "final-report.md")}function Read-RunState { $path = Get-RunStatePath if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path)) { return $null } try { return (Get-Content -LiteralPath $path -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json) } catch { return $null }}function Save-RunState { param( [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)] [object]$State ) $dir = Get-RunStateDir $path = Get-RunStatePath if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null } $State | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20 | Set-Content -LiteralPath $path -Encoding UTF8}function Add-RunStateNote { param( [string]$Key, [object]$Value ) $state = Read-RunState if ($null -eq $state) { return } if ($state.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains $Key) { $state.$Key = $Value } else { $state | Add-Member -NotePropertyName $Key -NotePropertyValue $Value } Save-RunState -State $state}

各脚本统一加载方式
在这些脚本顶部加入：
PowerShell$projectDir = if ($env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR) { $env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR } else { "D:\Code" }$runStateLib = Join-Path $projectDir ".claude\run-state\run-state.lib.ps1"if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $runStateLib) { . $runStateLib}else { function Get-RunStatePath { return "D:\Code\.claude\run-state\current.json" }}
建议应用到：
ai-start.ps1posttool-recorder.ps1stop-gate.ps1evidence-check.ps1close-run.ps1agent-self-check.ps1ps-guard.ps1

批量替换规则
把所有旧路径：
PowerShell"D:\Code\.ai-run\current.json""D:\Code\.claude\current.json""D:\Code\current.json"".\current.json"
替换为：
PowerShell(Get-RunStatePath)
示例：
PowerShell# 修改前$statePath = "D:\Code\.ai-run\current.json"# 修改后$statePath = Get-RunStatePath

最小验收命令
1. 检查状态路径是否统一
PowerShellSelect-String -Path D:\Code\*.ps1,D:\Code\.claude\**\*.ps1 ` -Pattern "\.ai-run\\current\.json|\.claude\\current\.json|D:\\Code\\current\.json|\.\\current\.json"
预期：无结果。

2. 验证 helper 输出真实路径
PowerShell$env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR = "D:\Code". D:\Code\.claude\run-state\run-state.lib.ps1Get-RunStatePath
预期：
PowerShellD:\Code\.claude\run-state\current.json

3. 验证 evidence-check run-complete
PowerShellpowershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File D:\Code\evidence-check.ps1 -Mode run-complete
预期：
JSON{"ok":false,"mode":"run-complete",...}
当前如果 tests_run=false，返回 ok=false 是正确的。

4. 验证 Stop 阶段总验收
PowerShellpowershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File D:\Code\evidence-check.ps1 -Mode run-complete -RequireCloseRun
预期：如果 tests_run=false 或 close_run_done=false，返回 ok=false。

5. 验证 close-run.ps1 不再错误关闭
当前 current.json 如果是：
JSON{ "tests_run": false, "close_run_done": false}
运行：
PowerShellpowershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File D:\Code\close-run.ps1
预期输出 block JSON，不应写入：
JSON"close_run_done": true

最终修改优先级

先加 D:\Code\.claude\run-state\run-state.lib.ps1

再改 close-run.ps1 顶部 preflight

再给 evidence-check.ps1 加 run-complete

最后批量替换所有旧状态路径为 Get-RunStatePath

用 Select-String 验证无旧路径残留

这三个补丁完成后，5-7 的问题基本闭合：路径统一、close-run 不会伪关闭、evidence-check 能做总验收，并且不会破坏现有 Write-Block JSON / fail-open 协议。
